name: Economics Honours
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Degree Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: All honours students must meet BA degree requirements as described in the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences section.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: For a course to fulfil a prerequisite, or for a required course to be accepted in an economics honours program, students must have achieved a grade of C- or higher.

sections.note: Students should fulfil Faculty requirements early in their programs and obtain broadly based backgrounds before entering upper division courses.

requirements.title: Students complete 120 units, as specified below

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the following prior to program declaration with at least a C- grade (unless otherwise indicated).

requirements.title: One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157
One additional 200 division ECON course (other than ECON 201, 220W, and 233)

sections.note:
Students who earn a grade of A- or better at Simon Fraser University on their first attempt in ECON 201 are exempt from the requirement of one additional 200 division ECON course.
These students should see Early Access to Upper Division Courses below for additional program information.

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition, students will receive credit for at least 48 upper division units in economics.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least two out of the following three course options.

sections.note:
In addition, students will receive credit for at least 48 upper division units in economics including all of.
Two 400 division ECON courses (excluding ECON 402, 403, 431, 435)

sections.title: Concentration in Economic Data Analysis

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students qualify for this concentration by completing six required courses of which at least four must be ECON courses.

requirements.title: 4 of CMPT 129, DATA 260, ECON 334 and 13 more

sections.note: Other courses with appropriate content can be used for credit upon prior application to the advisor.

sections.title: Concentration in Economic Analysis for Public Policy

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students qualify for this concentration by completing six required courses of which at least five must be ECON courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least four additional courses from the list below, of which at least three must be ECON.

requirements.title: 4 of ECON 104, ECON 260, ECON 291 and 25 more

sections.note: Other courses with appropriate content can be used for credit upon prior application to the advisor.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.
